collisions.method: NFKD-normalized stem and order-insensitive option-set checks; token Jaccard screening at 0.34 plus manual topic, concept, reasoning-path and learning-objective review. Candidate pool compared against the 973 pre-existing active questions and all 19 PYQ transcription files (18 official papers plus the 139-record partial duplicate subset); the retained 70 were also checked pairwise within the batch. Post-merge active count is 1,043. Supporting current-affairs, explanation-library, PYQ-transcription-audit and official-source metadata files were also inspected; they contain source notes, explanation mappings or transcription metadata rather than separate question stems/options.
